rules.cpu_cycles: Phase of most recently accepted ID instruction (id_valid && is_decoding); hold across bubbles/stalls. No speculative invalid-ID PC attribution. Wall-time boundary convention, not causal stall attribution.
rules.npu_cycles: Busy-edge state occupancy is a separate overlapping view; never add to CPU stage cycles
rules.exclusive: Every edge attributed to NPU state while busy, otherwise most recent accepted CPU instruction phase; sums exactly to hardware elapsed count. Accounting convention, not a CPU stall-cause proof.
rules.wait_weight: WAIT_TILE with tile_valid=0 only; other idle states are not DMA wait
rules.traffic: CPU LSU accepted byte enables and physical SRAM command reads/writes are distinct levels, not additive. SRAM reads are full32-bit accesses, including replay and instruction fetch. DMA reads counted at real R handshake.
rules.tensor: Logical tensor byte intervals exclude stride padding; macro_read_bytes also include repeated physical reads. Loader and post-completion SBA checks excluded.
